response.sql:
WITH team_averages AS (
    SELECT team_id,
           AVG(1.0 * w / NULLIF(g, 0)) AS average_win_rate,
           COUNT(*) AS record_count
    FROM manager_half
    GROUP BY team_id
),
with_mean AS (
    SELECT team_id,
           average_win_rate,
           record_count,
           average_win_rate - AVG(average_win_rate) OVER () AS difference
    FROM team_averages
)
SELECT team_id, average_win_rate, record_count, difference
FROM with_mean
ORDER BY difference DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: Each manager_half row is one record in the per-team count; AVG ignores null win rates, including rows where g is zero or w/g is missing. The overall mean is the unweighted mean of non-null team averages.
